name: Priyesh Nath Tiwari
tagline: Build the Network, Network Builds You.
summary: I'm a backend-focused full-stack developer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web applications, RESTful APIs and real-time systems — across live streaming, online trading and insurance CRM products.
intro: Day to day I work in Node.js, React.js, PHP/Laravel, PostgreSQL and MySQL on AWS and Docker — with hands-on experience in backend architecture, database design, payment gateway integration and performance optimisation.

points: Building Renova AI, an insurance renewal CRM for life, health and vehicle policies — React.js front end, Node.js REST APIs and a PostgreSQL data model for customers, policies and renewal tracking.

Authored page-level business requirement documents, translating each screen and workflow into API contracts, validation rules and database schema before development, using Claude AI as an analysis and drafting aid.
Designed renewal-lifecycle workflows covering policy expiry tracking, reminder scheduling and follow-up assignment across agent and admin roles.
Containerised services with Docker to keep local development and deployment environments consistent.
Designed analytics-driven REST APIs that capture and process real-time engagement data, measuring audience participation during live virtual events.
Built interactive engagement features — quizzes, emoji reactions, polls and surveys — to help clients analyse interest and improve retention.
Developed a real-time chat and announcement feature for presenters, load-balanced to support up to 5,000 concurrent users.
Integrated the Agora SDK, extended live streaming with custom background features and tuned overall streaming performance.
Built a CRM for vendor support operations with real-time complaint logging for systematic issue tracking.
Engineered multi-role access control for admins, supervisors and support staff that routed issues to the right department and improved accountability across the support lifecycle.
Built core modules of an online trading platform from scratch — deposit and withdrawal flows, market open/close operations and RESTful API integrations.
Developed a share-market web app for live gold and silver trading with market orders, limit orders, stop-loss and withdrawals.
Integrated an e-commerce module for buying physical gold and silver, combining trading and shopping in a single platform.
Delivered two MLM web applications in Core PHP and MySQL, tailored to client-specific business logic and compensation models, and contributed to logistics and e-commerce projects.
Engineered the backend for a multi-tier commission and bonus engine — hierarchical level plan, admin tools for franchise assignment and automated calculations across all distribution levels.
